verdict.rationale: Jan's docs and README describe a local-first app where everything can run on your own hardware and there is 'zero data collection until you say so.' That implies data stays under the user's control and nothing is retained by the vendor unless the user opts in. However, no evidence describes explicit retention settings or ways to delete chats or other data. Missing for 10: documented controls for deleting conversations and data, configurable retention policies, deletion behavior when using cloud providers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
